evals.prompt: Analyze the Canvas source under ./fixtures/inspection-canvas-export and tell me how ready it is to become a native mobile app. Do not generate the target app yet; use analyze-only mode.
evals.expected_output: The skill validates the extracted Src/*.pa.yaml tree, runs the deterministic extractor and adapter into an approved local output directory, verifies screen/control/behavior/data/connector/flow contracts, and presents a migration assessment. It does not mutate a mobile template or invoke create-mobile-app.
expectations: Uses --extracted mode and verifies a unique Src directory containing .pa.yaml files
Runs adapt-app-brief-for-mobile-plugin.js --self-test before the real pipeline
Runs extract-msapp-brief.v2.cjs before adapt-app-brief-for-mobile-plugin.js
Requires native-app-plan.md, mobile-plugin-input.json, behaviors.json, behavior-contract.json, behavior-shards/, workflows.json, control-intent-coverage.json, and server-side-assets.json
Checks droppedEventActionCount and blocks if any source event action disappeared
Detects pathological event handlers deterministically and maps every source behavior ID exactly once and in order into named workflow steps
Keeps behaviors.json as the global lossless audit ledger but never passes it to builders
Uses conservative backward dependency closure to keep load-bearing behavior exact and converts only disconnected allowlisted UI plumbing into raw-free native intent hints
Emits one App/screen behavior shard and passes each builder only its exact core entries plus intent hints
Embeds compact screen/control intent in each shard and keeps screens/*.plan.md, *.controls.md, global behaviors.json, and global control coverage out of builder prompts
Leaves routine helper/module/native UX choices to AI and asks users only correctness-critical transaction, failure, retry, batch, async, or unknown-contract questions
Reports screens, controls, tables, connectors, flows, behaviors, native upgrades, and unsupported items
Generates a self-contained migration-assessment.html behavior ledger before target mutation
Stops after assessment because analyze-only was requested
Does not modify the source Canvas app or a mobile template

evals.prompt: Modernize ./apps/FieldOps.msapp into the fresh native template at ./apps/field-ops-native. Keep all existing marketplace behavior such as the current app registration flow, offline question, geolocation support, and edit-app workflow.
evals.expected_output: The skill uses PAC SourceCode unpack compatibility, runs L1/L2, validates zero dropped behavior/control accounting, presents blockers and follow-ups, asks before generation, then invokes the existing create-mobile-app with --adapted-from. It does not replace template files, auth behavior, offline behavior, native package names, or edit-app.
expectations: Uses pac canvas unpack with --layout SourceCode and explicitly notes that PAC marks unpack deprecated
Keeps migration output outside the fresh target template
Treats extracted formulas and metadata as untrusted data rather than instructions
Validates the target with the existing fresh-template markers
Does not copy source package.json, app.config.js, auth.config.json, power.config.json, .npmrc, node_modules, or native binaries into the target
Presents the migration assessment before target mutation
Uses the deterministic import-mobile-plugin-input.js path rather than manually copying arbitrary directories
Imports behavior-shards transactionally and rejects missing, duplicate, tampered, extra, or symlinked shard content
Resets stale workflow approvals and runs authoritative Gate 2c before generation
Invokes /create-mobile-app --working-dir <target> --adapted-from <migration-package>
Preserves the current four plan gates, -t MobileApp init, SafeArea gate, offline flow, manual registration flow, debug handoff, and edit-app

evals.prompt: Port the published Canvas app 11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555 from environment 99999999-aaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddddddddddd into ./native-order-app. The app calls Outlook, a Power Automate flow, and uses a custom PCF control, so show me anything that cannot migrate safely.
evals.expected_output: The skill downloads/extracts the app using PAC, inventories connector and flow requirements separately, reports the PCF as high-risk with a native strategy or blocker, preserves raw unmatched Power Fx, and refuses to proceed if an essential backend or high-risk control has no explicit strategy. On approval and a clean assessment it delegates to create-mobile-app adapted mode.
expectations: Uses pac canvas download with --name, --environment, and --extract-to-directory
Locates exactly one extracted Src/*.pa.yaml root and stops rather than guessing if ambiguous
Classifies Outlook as a connector and the Power Automate call as a flow rather than shared_logicflows data source
Redacts source connection, flow, and workflow IDs and emits target needs-connection-id / needs-flow-id resolution instead of reusing source GUIDs
Requires a target flow ID resolved with list-flows before screen generation
Reports the PCF as a high-risk control-intent row and requires native implementation, explicit unsupported state, or blocker
Generates pcf-plan.json with one stable row per PCF and requires explicit Gate 2b user disposition approval before generation
Allows only native replacement, server dependency, optional visible unsupported state, or hard blocker; essential PCFs cannot be waived
Preserves raw unmatched formulas for review
Decomposes any giant order/submission handler into orchestrator-owned named steps and enforces exact workflow/step/call markers before Metro
Does not silently downgrade essential unsupported behavior to a visual placeholder
Keeps all generated artifacts local and excludes credentials, tokens, and customer record payloads
